PREFACE.

This little book holds the receipts our household has tried for many years. It is offered
to the young housekeeper in the hope that it will spare her some of the failures we have known.

39 LIZZIE'S COOK BOOK.

SPONGE CAKE.

3 eggs.
1 cup of sugar.
1 cup of flour.
1 teaspoonful of baking powder.

Beat the eggs and sugar together ten minutes, stir in the flour and the
powder, and bake in a moderate oven half an hour.

GINGER SNAPS.

Molasses . . . . . . . . . . . . 1 cup
Butter . . . . . . . . . . . . . ½ cup
Ginger . . . . . . . . . . . . . 1 tablespoonful
Flour . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 3 cups

Boil the molasses and pour it over the butter and ginger; when cool add
the flour, roll very thin, cut in rounds and bake in a quick oven. Keep
them in a tin box, well cov-
ered.

41.fulltext:
40 LIZZIE'S COOK BOOK.

MOLASSES CAKE.

One cup of molasses, one cup of sugar, half a cup of butter, two eggs, one
cup of sour milk, one teaspoonful of soda and three cups of flour. Bake in a
loaf.

PICKLED PEACHES.

7 pounds of peaches.
3 pounds of sugar.
1 pint of vinegar.
1 ounce of cloves.
1 ounce of stick cinnamon.

Boil the sugar, vinegar and spice together; put in the peaches a few at a
time and cook until tender.
